items.title: 12.5 Role of NO and NO2 in smog and PAN formation

source_refs.note: Topic 12.5 with the Did You Know box on Lahore smog, printed page 277.

blocks.text: NOx is responsible for numerous harmful effects on living organisms. Two of its atmospheric effects are photochemical smog (12.5.1) and the formation of peroxyacyl nitrates (12.5.2). Lahore smog consists of volatile organic compounds (VOCs), NOx, ground-level ozone, particulate matter PM2.5, CO and SO2.

blocks.prompt: What is in Lahore smog, and which of its components come from NOx chemistry?
blocks.explanation: Volatile organic compounds, nitrogen oxides, ground-level ozone, fine particulates (PM2.5), carbon monoxide and sulfur dioxide. The ozone and the peroxyacyl nitrates form from NOx and VOCs in sunlight, so they are products of NOx chemistry rather than direct emissions.

items: NOx harms living things; it drives photochemical smog and PAN formation; Lahore smog = VOCs, NOx, O3, PM2.5, CO, SO2.
